1	\section{Experiments}
2	\label{sec:experiments}
3	
4	We evaluate STA along three axes: as a diagnostic for reward hacking (\S\ref{sec:diagnostic}); as a training reward exhibiting meta-level Goodhart's Law (\S\ref{sec:goodhart}); and as a cross-logic protocol (\S\ref{sec:crosslogic}). We synthesize results into a hacking taxonomy (\S\ref{sec:taxonomy}).
5	
6	\subsection{Setup}
7	\label{sec:setup}
8	
9	We train Qwen3-4B with GRPO~\citep{deepseekmath} using $K{=}8$ rollouts per prompt for 500 steps (default) or 1000 where noted, across seeds $\{42,43,44\}$.
10	Training data is a fixed 500-example subset of FOLIO~\citep{folio} (\texttt{train\_500\_seed42.jsonl}), held constant across all seeds and conditions.
11	We use Prover9 for FOL and SWI-Prolog 8.4.2 for Prolog.
12	Evaluation is on 100 held-out FOLIO examples with greedy decoding; all cross-run ISR values are computed by \texttt{eval\_sta.py} which applies STA uniformly.
13	We report prove rate (PR), proved-only ISR (ISR$^*$, over proved samples only), hacking mode percentages (H7, H1), genuine rate, and mean component count.
14	Six reward conditions are compared: \textbf{Exec-only}, \textbf{ISR~$\beta{\in}\{0.1,0.3\}$}, \textbf{Random~$\beta{\in}\{0.1,0.3\}$}, and \textbf{SFT}.
15	Outputs are classified into H7, H1, and Genuine using text matching cross-validated with functional LOO analysis.
16	Full hyperparameters are in Appendix~\ref{app:setup}.
17	
18	\subsection{ISR as Diagnostic}
19	\label{sec:diagnostic}
20	
21	\begin{figure}[t]
22	\centering
23	\includegraphics[width=0.95\columnwidth]{figures/fig2_isr_collapse.pdf}
24	\caption{ISR collapse under exec-only GRPO (seed~42). PR rises 32\%$\to$96\% while proved-only ISR falls 0.642$\to$0.003 over 1000 steps. By step 1000, 94.8\% of proved samples have ISR${=}0$ and mean component count inflates 6.58$\to$18.55 (contradiction explosion).}
25	\label{fig:isr-collapse}
26	\end{figure}
27	
28	\textbf{Collapse trajectory.}
29	Figure~\ref{fig:isr-collapse} traces ISR and PR over training for exec-only GRPO (seed~42).
30	At 100 steps: PR${=}32$\%, ISR${=}0.642$.
31	By 500 steps: PR${=}93$\% but ISR${=}0.132$---87.1\% of proved samples embed the conclusion among the premises (H1).
32	At 1000 steps: PR${=}96$\% while ISR drops to 0.003 (H1${=}100$\%, mean components 18.55).
33	The ISR trajectory ($0.642{\to}0.132{\to}0.003$) is monotonically decreasing: extended training worsens structural degeneration, invisible to PR.
34	
35	\textbf{Cross-seed instability.}
36	The three exec-only seeds diverge radically: s42 hacks via H1 (PR${=}93$\%, H1${=}87.1$\%); s43 collapses to PR${=}14$\% (ISR${=}0$) via repetition---87\% of outputs hit the max token length; s44 reaches PR${=}98$\% via tautological collapse (H7${=}100$\%, mean components 2.04).
37	Despite PR$\in[14,98]$\%, all three seeds exhibit structural degeneration detectable by ISR.
38	The cross-seed PR $\sigma{=}\pm47$\,pp is itself a finding: aggregate metrics obscure qualitatively different failure modes (per-seed details in Table~\ref{tab:beta01-3seed}).
39	
40	\textbf{SFT baseline.}
41	A supervised baseline achieves PR${=}14$\% with ISR${=}0.571$: 92.9\% (13/14) of proved samples are genuine, only 1 exhibits H1, and no H7 instances occur.
42	The near-absence of hacking confirms that the structural degeneration is a consequence of RL reward optimization, not model capacity or data limitations.
43	
44	\subsection{Meta-Level Goodhart's Law}
45	\label{sec:goodhart}
46	
47	ISR-as-reward exhibits \emph{meta-level} Goodhart~\citep{manheim-goodhart-taxonomy}---the diagnostic itself becomes the target of gaming when optimized.
48	
49	\begin{table}[t]
50	\centering
51	\small
52	\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
53	\begin{tabular}{lcccccc}
54	\toprule
55	\textbf{Condition} & $\boldsymbol{\beta}$ & \textbf{PR\%}$\uparrow$ & \textbf{ISR}$^*$ & \textbf{H7\%} & \textbf{H1\%} & \textbf{Gen.\%} \\
56	\midrule
57	Base (0-shot) & --- & 12 & --- & --- & --- & --- \\
58	SFT & --- & 14 & 0.571 & 0 & 7 & \textbf{93} \\
59	\midrule
60	Exec-only$^\dagger$ & --- & 93 & 0.132 & 0 & 87 & 13 \\
61	ISR & 0.1 & 77{\scriptsize$\pm$14} & $\ddagger$ & \textbf{65} & 17 & ${\sim}$16 \\
62	Random & 0.1 & \textbf{85}{\scriptsize$\pm$6} & 0.086{\scriptsize$\pm$.04} & 0 & 81 & 19 \\
63	\midrule
64	ISR & 0.3 & 18 & 0.143 & --- & --- & --- \\
65	Random & 0.3 & 48 & 0.094 & --- & --- & --- \\
66	\bottomrule
67	\end{tabular}}
68	\caption{Goodhart landscape across reward conditions. 3-seed rows show mean$\pm$std (ISR/Random $\beta{=}0.1$); other rows are single seed. $^\dagger$Seed~42; see \S\ref{sec:diagnostic} for 3-seed divergence. $\ddagger$ISR$^*$ omitted: inflated by H7 gaming (Appendix Table~\ref{tab:beta01-3seed}). Best PR and Gen.\% bolded per group.}
69	\label{tab:goodhart-landscape}
70	\end{table}
71	
72	\textbf{Low-dose ISR ($\beta{=}0.1$): ISR-specific gaming.}
73	Table~\ref{tab:goodhart-landscape} summarizes results.
74	At $\beta{=}0.1$, 2/3 ISR seeds (s43, s44) are dominated by H7---a single premise identical to the conclusion, trivially achieving both high PR and ISR.
75	Across the three ISR seeds, H7 accounts for 64.5\% of proved samples (149/231); all three random controls show \emph{zero} H7 (0/256), confirming H7 is exclusively induced by the ISR signal.
76	Conclusion embedding (H1+H7) is GRPO-universal at 68--97\% across RL conditions: random produces only H1 (70.9--93.2\%), while ISR converts H1$\to$H7 without reducing the total (Figure~\ref{fig:hacking-composition}; per-seed: Appendix Table~\ref{tab:beta01-3seed}).
77	Random also achieves higher and more stable PR (85$\pm$6\% vs 77$\pm$14\%).
78	
79	\textbf{Premise-count confound.}
80	Seed~42 under ISR---the only seed not dominated by H7---shows higher raw ISR (0.415 vs 0.131 for random).
81	This is entirely a premise-minimization artifact: ISR-trained models produce shorter formalizations (mean 5.58 vs 8.46 components), and LOO is mathematically biased toward shorter inputs.
82	Restricting to genuine samples with $\geq$3 premises: ISR-genuine ISR${=}0.258$ ($n{=}11$) vs random-genuine ISR${=}0.243$ ($n{=}21$)---a 1.06$\times$ ratio, no meaningful advantage.
83	Of ISR s42's 25 nominally genuine samples, 15 have only 1--2 premises, where ISR$\geq0.5$ is a mathematical artifact.
84	
85	\textbf{High-dose ISR ($\beta{=}0.3$): classic Goodhart.}
86	At $\beta{=}0.3$, ISR causes PR to collapse to 18\%---a 5.2$\times$ degradation from exec-only---while the matched random control achieves PR${=}48$\%.
87	The two doses reveal a complete Goodhart trajectory~\citep{karwowski-goodhart-rl, gao-reward-overoptimization} at the meta level: low-dose proxy gaming (ISR inflation via H7) followed by high-dose performance collapse, with the proxy being gamed itself a gaming detector.
88	Under the taxonomy of \citet{manheim-goodhart-taxonomy}, $\beta{=}0.3$ exemplifies extremal Goodhart while $\beta{=}0.1$ instantiates a meta-level variant.
89	
90	\subsection{Cross-Logic Diagnostic Transfer}
91	\label{sec:crosslogic}
92	
93	We replicated both experiments using SWI-Prolog 8.4.2 (full results: Appendix Table~\ref{tab:prolog-crosslogic}).
94	Prolog exec-only confirms diagnostic transfer (2/3 seeds with ISR${\approx}0$ despite moderate-high PR); the low ISR reflects \emph{redundant coding} (repeated ground facts), not absent reasoning---contrasting the metric-gaming high ISR under Prolog ISR-reward.
95	ISR-as-reward yields universal Goodhart with 0\% genuine across 185 proved samples (stronger than the FOL ${\sim}16$\% residual), via three distinct mechanisms: s42 clean H7 tautologies (ISR$^*{=}1.000$); s43 uppercase pseudo-Prolog functionally equivalent to H7 ($n_{\text{nec}}{=}1$, 38/38); s44 query-as-fact gaming, converting NL to snake\_case atoms used as both fact and query (ISR$^*{=}0.912$, $n_{\text{nec}}{=}1$, 95/97).
96	The diversity of pathways under identical data and reward shows Goodhart here is a family of convergent exploits; the text-classifier bypass by s44 motivates functional cross-validation of automated diagnostics.
97	
98	\subsection{Hacking Taxonomy}
99	\label{sec:taxonomy}
100	
101	\begin{figure}[t]
102	\centering
103	\includegraphics[width=0.9\columnwidth]{figures/fig3_hacking_composition.pdf}
104	\caption{Hacking composition across reward conditions (proved samples). ISR converts H1 (conclusion embedding) into more extreme H7 (conclusion duplication) without reducing total hacking; SFT is near-zero hacking (92.9\% genuine).}
105	\label{fig:hacking-composition}
106	\end{figure}
107	
108	The seven modes (quantitative breakdown and definitions in Appendix~\ref{app:hacking-modes}, Table~\ref{tab:hacking-taxonomy-app}): \textbf{H1} (GRPO-universal, 68--97\%), \textbf{H7} (ISR-specific, 64.5\% under $\beta{=}0.1$ vs.\ 0\% random), \textbf{tautological} (exec-only s44, 94\%), \textbf{repetition} (exec-only s43, 87\% hit max length), \textbf{contradiction explosion} (mean 18.55 components at 1000 steps), \textbf{complexity-without-utility} (Random $\beta{=}0.1$, 3.8\%), \textbf{query-as-fact} (Prolog ISR s44, bypasses text classifiers).
109	The reward signal determines hacking \emph{composition} but not \emph{prevalence}: total conclusion-in-premise rates are comparable across ISR and random (${\sim}82$\% pooled), but ISR converts H1 into H7.
110	SFT remains the only condition with near-zero hacking (Figure~\ref{fig:hacking-composition}), confirming hacking is RL-reward-specific.
111

Now I have the full picture. Let me analyze the Action Matrix against the review report and provide my independent assessment.

The review report has 8 "Questions for Authors" (4 from R1, 4 from R2). Let me also check the review_issues.yaml to see if I missed anything.

From review_issues.yaml, I see these issues:
1. R1-W1 (Critical): β=0.3 single seed, abstract '87%' single seed, eval set 100 examples
2. R1-W2 (Critical): ISR framing - "maximal tightness", "genuine" terminology, ρ=-0.049 buried


3. R2-W1 (Critical): Limitations section format - needs independent \section
4. R2-W2 (Critical): Single model/dataset, title plural implies generality

Then there are several major warnings: the s43 eval protocol mixing sampling and greedy approaches, the "solver-agnostic" claim that's too broad, an unfair SFT baseline comparison, insufficient differentiation from Kim et al., the Meta-Goodhart novelty framing issue, and what appears to be another warning that got cut off.

Moving through the minor issues now: precision and recall details for the H1/H7 classifiers, the justification for the uniform distribution, code and data availability, and some numbering inconsistencies. There's also a critical gap in the references that needs addressing.

The action matrix shows I've mapped most of the critical and major issues to specific review findings, though a few mappings are still pending completion.

Now looking at the first substantive question about C4 — whether limiting the scope in approach A versus B is sufficient, or if I need to add model experiments. Both reviewers flagged this as critical/major, with R2 specifically calling for either additional experiments across different model scales and architectures, or explicit scope limitations in the title and claims.

The upgrade path to a 4/6 score mentions adding significance tests, running with β=0.3 across 3 seeds, and including another logic type like SMT-LIB or Lean, but it doesn't explicitly require a second model. That said, R2's core weakness is the narrow empirical scope — just one 1.5B model with two logic types. Approach A of simply limiting scope is risky given R2's Critical rating; for a findings track it might work, but for the main conference it probably won't be enough.

Adding Qwen3-1.5B is pragmatic but limited — testing another size within the same family shows scale sensitivity rather than architectural generality, which doesn't directly address the diversity the upgrade path seems to want. Still, the rubric doesn't explicitly demand architectural diversity, just model or logic type variation. My best move is combining Approach A with running Qwen3-1.5B on the execution-only subset — that's a reasonable middle ground that demonstrates the ISR collapse pattern holds across scales without requiring a full second evaluation. Going with just Approach A risks rejection because reviewers might see it as avoiding the real problem rather than solving it. 条件实验。

Actually, wait - I should think about this more carefully. The reviewer says "one model size (1.5B)" which is wrong (it's actually Qwen3-4B based on the paper). But the point stands - only one model was tested. Adding Qwen3-1.5B shows the phenomenon persists at different scales. This is actually a reasonable choice because:
1. Same tokenizer/architecture eliminates confounds
2. Shows scale doesn't matter (or does)
3. 4 GPU·h is affordable
4. Different architecture (LLaMA) would require new prompting templates, potentially new bugs, and more GPU time

So Qwen3-1.5B is a reasonable choice for the deadline. Not as strong as LLaMA, but pragmatic and still valuable.

**Q2: β=0.3 补 seed 后是否需要更新 dose-response narrative?**

Yes. The current narrative only has one data point at β=0.3, but adding three seeds changes things. I should report mean±std for β=0.3 like I do for β=0.1, and if the cross-seed variance is high, that reinforces the instability finding. If β=0.3 shows consistent collapse across seeds, the "classic Goodhart" claim at high dose becomes much stronger. I'll need to update Table 1 to show the three-seed means for that row, which directly addresses the "anecdote not trajectory" criticism.

**Q3: M2 SFT baseline — binomial CI 够不够？需要 PR-matched baseline 吗？**

The reviewer's concern about SFT PR... The reviewer didn't explicitly ask for a PR-matched baseline, so I can frame this as a FOLIO-specific discussion point in the rebuttal. I realize we can actually run the H1/H7 classifier on the 100-step checkpoint outputs from plan003 without new experiments—this would let us check whether hacking patterns emerge at PR=32%, which is closer to the SFT baseline's 14%. So my recommendation is to combine the binomial CI with the proposed rewording, plus this supplementary H1/H7 analysis on the early checkpoint.

Now I'm checking the review issues against what we've actually addressed. Most of the 15 issues map to our action items, but I'm noticing that Q1 about the ISR collapse trajectory is only partially covered—the reviewer specifically wants to see the s43/s44 execution-only collapse across multiple checkpoints (100→500→1000), not just single snapshots. And Q4 about inter-annotator agreement for the taxonomy isn't in our plan at all.

Looking at R2's questions, the meta-Goodhart distinction and third logic type are handled, but the ISR plus anti-gaming regularization and Shapley versus LOO comparisons are more discussion points than experiments. The bigger gap is R1-Q4: the reviewer wants to know about our annotation methodology for the 200-output taxonomy—whether it's single-annotator or multi-annotator work, and what the agreement metrics are.

I should clarify that our classification is actually automated using text-matching and functional LOO rather than manual annotation, and we can point to the precision/recall already reported in M1. For the anti-gaming regularization question, that's something to address thoughtfully in the rebuttal as future work rather than a new experiment. The Shapley versus LOO comparison belongs in the Discussion as a limitation. On the ISR side, R1 is asking for the collapse trajectory across all three seeds (s42, s43, s44), not just s42—we have 500-step data for all of them but only 1000-step for s42, so we might need to show all three trajectories in a figure or supplementary text.

Looking at what actually requires new experiments: R1-Q1 might need 1000-step runs for the other seeds unless we can argue they've already fully collapsed by 500 steps; R1-Q2 just needs a statistical test on existing data; R1-Q3 is already covered by the β=0.3 three-seed result; R1-Q4 is just a methodology clarification; R2-Q1 is reframing existing text; R2-Q2 could be proposed as future work or tackled with a quick experiment using a minimum-premise constraint; R2-Q3 is a discussion point; and R2-Q4 depends on whether we're running Qwen3-1.5B.

For the β=0.3 seed experiments, I need to be strict about configuration: use the exact same hyperparameters as the existing s42 runs, test only seeds 43 and 44, keep the training data constant (train_500_seed42.jsonl), evaluate with greedy decoding on the same 100-example held-out set, and run both ISR and Random variants for each seed to get 4 total runs.

The key baseline numbers I'm comparing against are plan002's eval PR of 0.18 (despite training at 0.5525) and plan017's eval PR of 0.48, both trained for 500 steps, so my new runs need to match that step count exactly.

## Action Matrix 独立审查

### 总体评估

Action Matrix 覆盖了 review_issues.yaml 全部 15 条 issue，无遗漏。方案整体合理，但有 3 处需要注意。

---

### 逐条评估

**C1 (β=0.3 补 seed)** ✅ 必须做

方案正确。注意事项：
- 必须同时补 ISR β=0.3 **和** Random β=0.3 各 2 seeds（s43+s44），共 4 runs。Action Matrix 标注 "β=0.3 ISR+random 各补"，但实验清单只列了 "β=0.3 ISR s43+s44 (~3 GPU·h)" 和 "β=0.3 random s43+s44 (~3 GPU·h)"——这是对的，总计 4 runs。
- 配置必须与现有 plan002-additive-b03-s42（ISR）和 plan017-additive-random-s42（random）完全一致：500 steps, K=8, lr=1e-6, train_500_seed42.jsonl。
- eval 必须 greedy decoding，100 例 held-out set，eval_sta.py 统一 STA。
- 完成后 Table 1 的 β=0.3 两行需改为 3-seed mean±std，dose-response narrative 需更新。**如果 3-seed β=0.3 variance 很大（像 exec-only σ=47pp），narrative 需要调整——"classic Goodhart collapse" 可能需要加 "with high variance" 限定**。

**C2 (ISR framing)** ✅ 无异议

"maximal tightness"→"syntactic component necessity"，"genuine"→"non-hacking" + 操作定义脚注。ρ=-0.049 上提。方向完全正确。

**C3 (Limitations 独立 section)** ✅ 无异议

ACL 要求独立 `\section{Limitations}`。但注意：当前论文 8 页边界已很紧。拆分后可能需要额外压缩其他章节 0.1-0.2 页。

**C4 (单模型/数据集)** — 需要更详细分析

见下方 Q1 专题回答。

**M1-M7, m1-m4** ✅ 全部合理，无异议。

---

### Q1: C4 方案 A vs B 的取舍

[severity: warning] **仅做方案 A（标题收窄）有被 R2 维持 Critical 的风险。**

R2 的 upgrade path 明确说 "To 4 (Borderline Accept): ... add one more logic type (e.g., SMT-LIB or Lean)"。注意 R2 要求的是 **逻辑类型** 而非模型——但 R2-W2 的 issue 是 "单一模型"。这两个是不同维度的 scope 问题。

**建议：方案 A + B 并行（标题收窄 + Qwen3-1.5B exec-only）。** 理由：
1. Qwen3-1.5B 是同族不同 scale——比不同架构的实验更干净（排除 tokenizer/prompt template 干扰），且 4 GPU·h 可承受
2. 只需跑 exec-only（验证 ISR collapse 跨 scale），不需要全 6 条件
3. 如果 1.5B 也出现 ISR collapse，直接证明 "phenomenon is scale-independent"
4. 如果 1.5B 不出现 collapse（可能因为模型太小学不会 hacking），本身也是有趣发现——可以放 discussion

**Qwen3-1.5B 是否合适？** 合适。原因：
- 同架构消除 confound
- 体量差异明显（4B → 1.5B）
- 时间/算力可控
- LLaMA 理论上更强（不同 tokenizer + 不同 pretraining data），但风险是需要调 prompt template，且如果结果异常很难归因

**不建议换 LLaMA**——DDL 前 11 天，调 prompt template + debug + 验证的风险太大。

### Q2: β=0.3 补 seed 后是否需要更新 dose-response narrative？

**是的，必须更新。** 具体需要：
1. Table 1 的 β=0.3 行：单 seed → 3-seed mean±std
2. §4.3 "High-dose ISR" 段落：更新数字
3. §4.3 最后的 dose-response 总结：如果 β=0.3 三 seed 一致 PR 低（都在 10-25%），叙事更强；如果有 seed 意外 PR 高，叙事需要 hedge
4. **关键**：R2 批评 "dose-response trajectory 高剂量端仅一个数据点"——3-seed 后这个批评直接解决
5. Discussion 中 "extremal Goodhart" 论断可以升级为 3-seed supported

### Q3: M2 SFT baseline — binomial CI 是否足够？

[severity: warning] **Binomial CI 必要但可能不够。建议补一个零成本分析。**

Reviewer 的核心担忧不是 sample size，而是 **PR confound**：PR=14% 时模型几乎不 prove，自然没机会 hack。Binomial CI 只解决 "13/14 genuine 是否可靠" 的统计问题，不解决 "PR=14% 下 hacking 机会有限" 的因果问题。

**建议补充**（不需要新实验）：
- 对 exec-only **100-step checkpoint**（plan003, PR=32%, ISR=0.642）运行 H1/H7 分类器。如果 PR=32% 时 hacking 已低/不存在，说明 RL early stage 也不 hack——支持 "RL-specific" claim。如果 PR=32% 时已有 H1，说明 hacking 随 PR 而非 RL 本身出现——需 hedge claim。
- 这只需要在现有 plan003 输出上跑 classifier，0 GPU·h。

不需要 PR-matched RL baseline（那需要新训练），但上述 100-step 分析可以部分回答。

### Q4: 遗漏的审稿意见

**Action Matrix 覆盖了 review_issues.yaml 全部 15 条 issue。** 但 "Questions for Authors" 中有 2 条需要注意：

1. **R1-Q4（taxonomy 标注方法论）**：Reviewer 问 "Was annotation done by one person or multiple? What is the inter-annotator agreement?" Action Matrix m1 只覆盖 precision/recall，没提标注方法论。**建议**：在 rebuttal 中明确说明分类是 **automated**（text-match + functional n_necessary），不是人工标注，因此 inter-annotator agreement 不适用——但需要报告 automated classifier 的 precision/recall（已在 m1 中）。

2. **R2-Q2（anti-gaming regularization）**：Reviewer 问 "Would ISR-as-reward work if combined with anti-gaming regularization?" 这不在 Action Matrix 中。**建议**：rebuttal 中用 1-2 句作为 future work 讨论（"minimum component count constraint would address H7 but not other modes; the diversity of gaming pathways suggests regularization needs to target multiple mechanisms simultaneously"），不需要新实验。

3. **R2-Q3（Shapley vs LOO）**：同上，rebuttal 讨论即可，不需要实验。

### Q5: "Questions for Authors" 中需要额外实验的

8 个 Questions 中：
- **R1-Q1**（3-seed ISR trajectory）：**不需要新实验**。已有 s42 三个时间点 + s43/s44 的 500-step 数据。可以在 rebuttal 中指出 s43/s44 在 500 步已经完全 collapse（s43 PR=14%/ISR=0, s44 H7=100%），延长训练无法改善已经 100% 退化的模型。
- **R1-Q2**（premise-count p-value）：**不需要**——在现有数据上做 bootstrap/Mann-Whitney。
- **R1-Q3**（β=0.3 3-seed）：**需要**——已在 C1 中。
- **R1-Q4**（标注方法论）：不需要实验。
- **R2-Q1**（meta-Goodhart 理论区分）：不需要实验。
- **R2-Q2**（anti-gaming regularization）：可选实验，但 DDL 压力下建议 rebuttal 讨论而非实验。如果要做，minimum-premise constraint 约 2 GPU·h。
- **R2-Q3**（Shapley）：不需要实验。
- **R2-Q4**（第三逻辑类型）：已由 C4 覆盖——如果补 Qwen3-1.5B，这部分 scope 问题缓解（但逻辑类型维度没解决）。

- **Problem**: GRPO with execution-only rewards trains neurosymbolic formalizers that achieve high solve rates but produce structurally degenerate outputs (reward hacking). - **Existing approaches & gaps**: Mellgren et al. (2025) hand-craft Prolog-specific structure penalties. EVOM (2026) uses scalar execution rewards only. - **Our contribution**: We propose STA (Solver Trace Ablation), applying component necessity testing (LOO ablation) to derive ISR as a **diagnostic metric** for structural integrity. Key findings:

  2.   3. Conclusion embedding (52-93% of proved samples) is GRPO-universal regardless of reward type; ISR reward restructures but doesn't reduce it
  4. Different reward formulations produce distinct, classifiable hacking strategies (7 modes identified, including ISR-specific "conclusion duplication with ISR inflation" and Prolog-specific "query-as-fact gaming")
  5. ISR measures syntactic component necessity, not semantic faithfulness — premise minimization inflates ISR without improving reasoning
  6. SFT baseline confirms hacking is RL-reward-specific (PR=14%, 92.9% genuine, near-zero hacking)
  7.   2. Single-seed GRPO results are unreliable (2/3 exec-only seeds collapse differently)
  3. ISR reward is unreliable as training signal at any dose: β=0.1 induces ISR-specific gaming, β=0.3 collapses PR. Apparent "genuine improvement" is premise minimization artifact. Use ISR for post-hoc diagnosis only.
  4. Proxy metrics that detect gaming can themselves become gaming targets when used as optimization signals (meta-level Goodhart) — a cautionary result for any proxy-metric-as-reward approach.
  5. Conclusion embedding is GRPO-universal (68-100%); reward shaping changes the composition of hacking, not its prevalence
  6. LOO-based metrics like ISR are mathematically biased by component count: fewer premises → higher ISR, independent of reasoning quality
  7. Text-match hacking classifiers have blind spots (Prolog s44 query-as-fact gaming bypassed strict classifier); always cross-validate with functional analysis (n_necessary distribution)
- **Headline result**: "We demonstrate that ISR — a component necessity metric derived from solver trace ablation — serves as a powerful diagnostic for reward hacking in GRPO-trained formalizers, but fails as a training signal due to meta-level Goodhart's Law. 数据收集完成。以下是独立审查结论。

---

## 逐项审查

### 1. 遗漏的审稿意见

Action Matrix 覆盖了核心意见，但遗漏了三个 recurring theme：

**遗漏 A：β sweep 只有 2 点，不支持 "dose-response" 叙事。** 多轮 dream review 一致指出，用 β=0.1 和 β=0.3 两个点说 "dose-response pattern" 或 "sharp transition" 不够严谨。当前 action plan 补了 β=0.3 multi-seed，但没有加中间值（如 β=0.2）。如果不加中间 β，**必须**在写作中将 "dose-response trajectory" 降级为 "two-dose comparison" 或类似措辞。加一个 β=0.2 单 seed 实验（~2 GPU·h）代价很低，但要权衡 GPU budget。

**遗漏 B：plan018-random-b01-s43-r2 指标不完整。** Registry 中该实验只记录了 h7/h1/genuine 计数，缺少 PR 和 ISR 数值。论文报 Random β=0.1 "85±6" 的 3-seed PR，需要确认 s43 的 PR=0.88 是从哪计算的。如果只有 hacking taxonomy 数据而无 eval_sta 完整输出，3-seed 统计的 provenance 有缺口。建议在补实验时 **重新跑 s43 random 的完整 eval_sta**，确保 registry 数据链完整。

**遗漏 C：paper_framing.md 中标注但 action matrix 未覆盖的写作修复。** 包括：(1) "Dense+automatic" → "conditionally dense"；(2) RIP framing 需降级为 "inspired by"；(3) 移除所有 "Pareto-improving" 语言。这些在当前论文中可能已修复（上轮写作 worker 已处理），但 action matrix 未列为 action item，需确认。

### 2. C4 模型选择：Qwen3-1.5B vs LLaMA

**Qwen3-1.5B 是在 DDL 约束下的合理选择**，但需注意以下权衡：

| 选择 | 优势 | 劣势 |
|------|------|------|
| **Qwen3-1.5B** | 同架构 → 精确隔离 scale 效应；共享 tokenizer → 无需调 prompt；~4 GPU·h | 审稿人可能不认为 "同家族不同 scale" 是真正的 "第二模型"；无法回答 "architecture-specific?" |
| **LLaMA-3-3B** | 不同架构+训练数据 → 泛化性更强 | 不同 tokenizer → prompt 格式需调整；基础设施风险高（GRPO pipeline 可能需要适配）；训练可能更久 |

**我的建议**：用 Qwen3-1.5B，但配合两个写作措施：
1. 标题从 "Neurosymbolic Formalizers"（复数暗示泛化）收窄为 "a GRPO-Trained Neurosymbolic Formalizer" 或加限定 "on Qwen3"
2. Limitations 明确写："We validate scale invariance within the Qwen3 family (4B and 1.5B); cross-architecture validation (e.g., LLaMA) remains untested."

如果 Qwen3-1.5B 实验中 ISR collapse **未复现**（小模型可能 PR 太低没机会 hack），那这个实验反而会削弱论文。建议设定 **kill criteria**：如果 Qwen3-1.5B exec-only 500 steps 的 PR < 20%，则 ISR collapse 无从诊断，实验无法作为验证证据——改为在 Limitations 中讨论即可。

### 3. β=0.3 补 seed 配置关键警告

**[severity: warning] β=0.3 s42 训练时使用了 binary ISR approximation，而非 full STA。**

Registry 记录 plan002-additive-b03-s42 的训练 ISR 为 "binary approx, not real ISR"。如果新的 s43/s44 使用当前代码库的 full STA 计算训练 reward，**三个 seed 的训练信号不一致**，无法做公平的 3-seed 聚合。

有两个解决方案：
- **方案 A**（推荐）：s43/s44 严格复制 s42 的训练配置（包括 binary ISR approximation），确保 3-seed 一致性
- **方案 B**：3 个 seed 全部用 full STA 重跑，但这意味着原 s42 数据作废，GPU 成本翻倍（9 GPU·h → 仅 β=0.3）

**如果无法确认 s42 的精确训练配置**，应在论文中将 β=0.3 降级为 "single-seed exploratory result"，不做 3-seed 聚合。

此外还需确认：
- β=0.3 s42 用的是 K=8 还是 K=4？（早期实验用 K=4，后改 K=8）
- 学习率、max_completion_length 是否与 β=0.1 实验一致？
- 训练步数是否一致（500 steps）？

### 4. 优先级排序评估

当前隐含排序大致合理，但建议调整：

**第一优先级（立即执行，不占 GPU）**：
- C3：Limitations 独立 section（5 分钟 LaTeX 改动）
- C2：ISR framing 写作修改
- M1：确认 s43 eval 协议问题的处理方案（是重新跑 greedy eval 还是从统计中移除）
- M4-M7：纯写作修改

**第二优先级（GPU 并行）**：
- C1：β=0.3 补 seed（**但先确认 s42 训练配置再开跑**）
- C4：Qwen3-1.5B exec-only
- M1：s43 greedy re-eval（0.5 GPU·h）

**第三优先级（实验完成后）**：
- 用新数据更新论文
- m1-m4 minor fixes
- bootstrap CI 计算

**时间风险**：10.5 GPU·h / 2 GPU ≈ 6h 壁钟时间。但这个项目有大量基础设施失败史（s43 exec-only 失败 3 次才成功，SFT 失败 3 次）。建议 **预留 50% buffer**（~9h 壁钟），距 ARR 5/25 还有 11 天，时间充足。

### 5. 写作修改技术性问题

**一处值得商榷**：

M2 "RL-specific" → "optimization-aggressiveness-correlated" 过度矫正。SFT 的 PR=14% 低不意味着它"没机会 hack"——SFT 产出的 14 个 proved 样本中 92.9% 是 genuine，说明 SFT 确实不倾向于走捷径，而非样本量太小看不出来。问题是 n=14 的置信区间宽（binomial 95% CI ≈ [66%, 100%]），但 "RL-specific" 作为方向性判断仍然成立。建议：**保留 "RL-specific"，但加 caveat**——"confirmed as RL-specific by an SFT baseline (92.9% genuine; 95% CI [66%, 100%], n=14); though the lower SFT pass rate (14% vs 93%) limits direct comparison, the near-absence of structural shortcuts in SFT outputs is consistent with hacking being driven by reward optimization rather than model capacity."

**其余写作修改均正确**：
- "maximal tightness" → "syntactic component necessity" ✅
- ρ=-0.049 前置 ✅
- "genuine" → "non-hacking" + 操作定义 ✅
- "solver-agnostic" → "validated on two solvers" ✅
- "meta-Goodhart" → "first empirical demonstration" ✅

---

**总结**：方案整体可行且优先级基本合理。最大风险是 **β=0.3 训练配置一致性**——如果 s42 用了 binary ISR 而新 seed 用 full STA，3-seed 聚合不成立。建议在开跑之前先确认 s42 的训练脚本参数。次要风险是 Qwen3-1.5B 可能 PR 太低无法触发 ISR collapse。两个风险都可以通过设定 kill criteria 管理。

### 1.10 Random β=0.3 (Goodhart landscape)

论文: PR=48, ISR=0.094, components=9.6。
Registry plan017-additive-random-s42: PR=0.48, ISR*=0.0943, components=9.6。 ✓

### 1.11 ISR β=0.3 (无独立 eval registry 项)

论文: PR=18, ISR*=0.143。
Registry plan002-additive-b03-s42 仅记录训练统计（无 eval_*），但与 framing 一致：framing 给出 mean_isr=0.026，而 0.143 × 0.18 = 0.0257 ≈ 0.026，所以 paper 的 0.143（proved-only）与 framing 的 0.026（mean）数学一致。 ✓

### 1.12 Premise-count-matched (§3.2 / Limitations)

论文: 1.06× (ISR-genuine ISR=0.258 n=11 vs random-genuine ISR=0.243 n=21)。
Framing: ISR s42 genuine n_prem≥3: n=11, mean ISR=0.2578; Random s42 genuine n_prem≥3: n=21, mean ISR=0.2434。Ratio=1.06×。 ✓

### 1.13 Component-count s42

论文: ISR s42 mean=5.58 components, Random s42 mean=8.46 components。
Registry plan002-b01-s42: component_count_mean=5.58。plan018-random-s42: component_count_mean=8.46。 ✓

### 1.14 NLI Limitation (Conclusion / Appendix)

论文: Spearman ρ=−0.049, p=0.187。
Registry plan014-downstream-nli-s42: spearman_rho=-0.049, spearman_p=0.187。 ✓

### 1.15 H7 pooled rate

论文: 64.5% (149/231), Random 0% (0/256)。
- ISR pooled: (13 + 59 + 77)/(81+61+89) = 149/231 = 64.50% ✓
- Random pooled: (0+0+0)/(79+88+89) = 0/256 ✓

---

## 2. 硬约束检查

| 约束 | 状态 | 证据 |
|------|------|------|
| D051: "2.4x" 已作废，不应出现 | ✅ PASS | grep `2\.4(x|×|\\times)` 在 paper/*.tex 0 matches |
| 旧的 "3.2x" 也已移除 | ✅ PASS | grep `3\.2(x|×|\\times)` 0 matches |
| Hacking taxonomy = 7 modes (非 6) | ✅ PASS | abstract/method/conclusion/appendix 均说 "seven" / "7"。`six modes` 0 matches |
| ISR β=0.1 不应标 "no hacking" | ✅ PASS | "near-zero hacking" 仅用于 SFT (92.9% genuine)；ISR β=0.1 在论文中明确标注 H7 主导 |
| s44 Prolog STA: query-as-fact gaming, 0% genuine | ✅ PASS | appendix tab:prolog-crosslogic 标 Gen=0%，footnote $^b$ 解释功能性 H7 (95/97) |
| plan013 vs plan017 不简化为 "additive vs convex" | ✅ PASS | grep 0 matches |
| C006: ISR 双语义区分（exec-only low ISR=冗余编码 vs ISR-reward high ISR=metric gaming） | ✅ PASS | conclusion §"Interpreting ISR" 和 appendix §"What ISR measures" 均明确区分 |

---

## 3. 内部一致性检查

### 3.1 跨章节核心数字一致

- 93% PR + 87% H1: abstract / intro / experiments §3.2 / appendix。一致 ✓
- 64.5% H7 vs 0% random: abstract / intro / experiments §3.2 / appendix。一致 ✓
- 1.06× premise-matched: abstract / intro §1 / experiments §3.2 / appendix。一致 ✓
- 18% vs 48%（β=0.3 ISR vs Random）: abstract / intro / experiments §3.2 / appendix。一致 ✓
- 92.9% genuine SFT: abstract / intro / experiments §3.1 / Table 1 / appendix。一致 ✓
- 3/3 Prolog seeds gaming, 0% genuine: abstract / intro / experiments §3.3 / conclusion / appendix。一致 ✓
- 7 hacking modes: method §2.4 / experiments §3.4 / conclusion / appendix §C。一致 ✓
- 6 reward conditions: method §2.3 / experiments §3 setup / conclusion。一致 ✓ (Exec-only / ISR β=0.1 / ISR β=0.3 / Random β=0.1 / Random β=0.3 / SFT = 6)
- ISR 崩塌 0.642→0.132→0.003: abstract / intro / experiments §3.2 / appendix §F。一致 ✓

### 3.2 交叉引用

所有 `\ref{}` 标签均能在 paper/*.tex 找到对应定义：
- sec:setup, sec:diagnostic, sec:goodhart, sec:crosslogic, sec:taxonomy, sec:taxonomy-method, sec:method, sec:task, sec:sta, sec:rewards, sec:experiments, sec:related-work ✓
- fig:sta-overview, fig:isr-collapse, fig:hacking-composition, fig:prolog-comparison ✓
- tab:goodhart-landscape, tab:hyperparams, tab:hacking-taxonomy-app, tab:fol-detailed / tab:beta01-3seed, tab:prolog-detailed / tab:prolog-crosslogic ✓
- alg:sta ✓
- eq:isr ✓
- app:setup, app:algorithm, app:extended-discussion, app:hacking-modes, app:detailed-results ✓

### 3.3 Minor 内部不一致

#### 3.3.1 H1 mean 算法不一致（simple mean vs pooled）

- **H7 ISR β=0.1 (论文 65%)**: pooled = 149/231 = 64.5% → 论文用 pooled
- **H1 ISR β=0.1 (论文 17%)**: simple mean = (51.9+0+0)/3 = 17.3% vs pooled = 42/231 = 18.2% → 论文用 simple mean

这与 framing 一致（framing 也是混用），但同一行同一指标用两种平均方法略不规范。**Impact: 0.8pp 差异，不影响 claim**。

建议：在 caption 或正文 footnote 中说明 H7/H1 用 simple mean of seeds（而非 pooled）。

#### 3.3.2 Appendix line 414 微小 rounding

> "ISR$^*=0.642$ at 100 steps $\to$ $0.132$ at 500 steps ($-79.4$\%) $\to$ $0.003$ at 1000 steps ($-99.6$\% from step 100)."

(0.642−0.003)/0.642 = 0.9953 = **99.5%**，paper 写 99.6%。Abstract 写 99.5%（正确）。

**建议**：把 appendix 改为 99.5%，与 abstract 对齐。

#### 3.3.3 Appendix tab:beta01-3seed exec-only s44 ISR* = 0.582

Registry 值 0.5816 — 四舍五入应为 0.582 ✓。但 framing 文本写 0.57（粗略），paper 用更精确的 0.582。无问题。

#### 3.3.4 Proved-only vs mean ISR 表达约定

Paper 全文使用 ISR* = proved-only。Registry 中部分 metrics 仅存 mean_isr（all samples，含 unproved=0）。当看到 paper 给的 0.902 (ISR s44) vs registry 0.803 (mean_isr) 时，需理解：proved_only = mean_isr / PR (∵ unproved=0)。

- ISR β=0.1 s44: 0.803/0.89 = 0.902 ✓
- Prolog STA s44: 0.885/0.97 = 0.912 ✓
- ISR β=0.3 s42: 0.0257/0.18 = 0.143 ✓ (framing 写 0.026 = mean, paper 写 0.143 = proved-only)
- Random β=0.3 s42: 0.0453/0.48 = 0.0944 ✓

约定一致，无错误。但**建议在 §3.1 Setup 中明确 footnote**：「除非另有说明，所有 ISR 报告均为 proved-only ISR* ≡ mean of ISR over proved samples」。Setup 已在第 13 行说明「we report ... proved-only ISR (ISR*, over proved samples only)」，已 OK。

---

## 4. 总结与建议修改

### 4.1 总体评价

**论文数据层面 PASS**。所有定量 claim 均可追溯至 registry，跨章节一致，硬约束全部遵守。

### 4.2 建议修改（均为 minor）

1. **Appendix line 414**: `−99.6%` → `−99.5%` 以与 abstract 99.5% 对齐。
2. **Table 1 caption 或 §3.2 footnote**: 添加一句说明 3-seed mean H7/H1 是 simple mean across seeds（非 pooled），以避免审稿人质疑 H7=65% 与 H1=17% 计算口径差异。
3. **可选**: appendix line 388 Prolog STA s44 后 footnote $^b$ 提到「strict classifier reports Genuine=100%」，但表中已经写 Gen=0%（覆盖），建议在表内 Gen 列标注 `0$^b$` 或类似显眼标记，避免读者误读 ground-truth 标签。当前 footnote 在右下角，可能被忽略。

### 4.3 无 critical 错误

- 没有引用作废的 2.4× 优势
- 没有混淆 binary _fast_fn 训练 ISR 与 full STA eval ISR
- 没有把 s44 Prolog STA 误标为 genuine
- 7-mode taxonomy 全文一致
- C001 数据约束（train_500_seed42.jsonl）在 setup 和 appendix 均明确

报告结束。
